title: Simplify shared-native caller constants while preserving every boundary (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope
Reduce the frozen #6902 caller from 2,492 events to 1,194 by rewriting 38 constant blocks. Every nonconstant anchor and native boundary is preserved. The ordinary-work allowance falls by 172,789,760; paid/productive histograms are unchanged. No new κ.

## Sources and verification
Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
Head: 16bfe27268808ead5b9a1ad0048a50483c430156.
Source #6902: e4d42607f24d7a049b0fca329dc4c34882405c25; hashes in SOURCES.json.

Run:
`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-caller-constant-blocks`

Fresh Python 3.12.14 replay passed all three registered checks, including normal/optimized checks and the separate exact whole-caller oracle. All 60,800 changed-block entries and mutation controls pass. Expected: PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE. Committed bytes/modes and whitespace pass. Latest #6902 changes leave these caller/native/root inputs unchanged.

## Limits and credit
No runtime benchmark, rounded-execution equality or supplier admission. All five framework assumptions remain; selected frontier unchanged. Proof, prior separate AI review and next questions are included.

@CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Astra/Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds (#6902/#6833), zxv (#6726), thu-nmrc (#6716) and retained authors. Apache-2.0.
